sources.snippet: What is distilbart-cnn-6-6? DistilBART CNN 6-6 is a compressed version of the BART model specifically optimized for text summarization tasks. It was trained on the CNN/DailyMail dataset and represents a careful balance between performance and efficiency, achieving significant speed improvements while maintaining strong summarization capabilities.
